Class AuthenticationRepository

java.lang.Object
repositories.AuthenticationRepository
public class AuthenticationRepository extends Object
Handles user authentication and manages user-related operations within the system. This class provides methods to create, read, update, and delete user accounts, manage user sessions, and perform role and authentication-related actions.

    • createNewUser

      public boolean createNewUser(User user)
      Creates a new user and adds them to the repository if they do not already exist.
      Parameters:
      user - The user object to be added. Must contain valid information such as a unique email.
      Returns:
      True if the user was successfully added; false if the user already exists in the repository.

    • getAllUsers

      public List<User> getAllUsers()
      Retrieves a list of all users in the repository.
      Returns:
      A List of User objects representing all the users in the repository.

    • getUserByEmail

      public Optional<User> getUserByEmail(String email)
      Retrieves a user from the repository based on their email address.
      Parameters:
      email - The email address of the user to retrieve. Must not be null and should be in a valid email format.
      Returns:
      An Optional<User> containing the user if found; otherwise, an empty Optional.

    • deleteUser

      public boolean deleteUser(String email)
      Deletes a user from the repository based on their email address. If the user to be deleted is the currently logged-in user, they will be logged out of the session automatically.
      Parameters:
      email - The email address of the user to be deleted. Must not be null and should be in a valid email format.
      Returns:
      True if the user was successfully deleted; false if the user does not exist in the repository.

    • deleteUser

      public boolean deleteUser(User user)
      Deletes a user from the repository if they exist. If the user to be deleted is currently logged into the session, they will also be logged out automatically.
      Parameters:
      user - The User object to be deleted. The user's email must not be null and should be in a valid email format.
      Returns:
      True if the user was successfully deleted; false if the user does not exist in the repository.

    • changeRole

      public boolean changeRole(String email, String roleId)
      Changes the role of a user identified by their email address. If the user exists in the repository, their role is updated to the specified role ID.
      Parameters:
      email - The email address of the user whose role is to be changed. Must not be null and should be in a valid email format.
      roleId - The new role ID to assign to the user. Cannot be null or empty.
      Returns:
      True if the user's role was successfully updated; false if the user does not exist.

    • changeRole

      public boolean changeRole(User user, String roleId)
      Changes the role of a user if the user exists in the repository. Updates the user's role to the specified role ID.
      Parameters:
      user - The user whose role is to be changed. Must not be null and must contain a valid email.
      roleId - The new role ID to assign to the user. Cannot be null or empty.
      Returns:
      True if the user's role was successfully updated; false if the user does not exist.

    • doLogin

      public boolean doLogin(String email, String password)
      Attempts to log a user into the system using the provided email and password. Validates the user's credentials and starts a session if the credentials are correct.
      Parameters:
      email - The email address of the user attempting to log in. Must not be null and should be in a valid email format.
      password - The password of the user attempting to log in. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      True if the login was successful; false otherwise.

    • doLogout

      public boolean doLogout()
      Logs the user out of the current session. This method clears the session data to log out the currently active user.
      Returns:
      True if the logout operation was successful.

    • getRole

      public String getRole(String email)
      Retrieves the role ID of the user associated with the specified email address. If the user with the given email address is not found, this method returns null.
      Parameters:
      email - The email address of the user whose role ID is to be retrieved. Must not be null and should be in a valid email format.
      Returns:
      The role ID of the user as a String, or null if the user is not found.

    • getSession

      public UserSession getSession()
      Retrieves the current user session.
      Returns:
      The UserSession object representing the current active session.

    • getCurrentUserEmail

      public String getCurrentUserEmail()
      Retrieves the email address of the currently logged-in user. This method fetches the email of the user associated with the current session. If no user is currently logged in, the behavior of this method depends on the implementation of session.getUser() and may result in a null pointer exception.
      Returns:
      The email address of the current user as a String.
